subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR's current-attempt replay metadata contract and server-error retry-before-failover behavior be accepted as the canonical fix path for the linked provider-error retry bug?
rationale: The patch is a plausible best code shape, but it changes SDK-exported harness result semantics and provider retry ordering, which automation cannot accept on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Require proof then accept this shape
options.body: Ask for redacted full-runner or gateway proof, refresh the branch, then proceed if maintainers accept the optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata field and conservative fallback.

options.title: Choose the alternate open fix
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 as the preferred candidate only if maintainers verify its proof, CI, and mergeability are stronger at current head.

options.title: Pause the API direction
options.body: If adding an attempt-result field is not the desired harness contract, pause this PR and request a different same-attempt side-effect signal.

recommendation.title: Require proof then accept this shape
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted full-runner or gateway proof, refresh the branch, then proceed if maintainers accept the optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata field and conservative fallback.
